# GUIDES: Write code to calculate and plot the vibration of the non-broken and broken limo. You should use two subplots -- one for each limo -- and fix the axes to be the same.
# The first plot should be the non-broken limo.
nrows = 2
ncols = 1
fig_vib, axs_vib = plt.subplots(nrows, ncols, figsize=(10, 8))

fixed_vibration = stretch_limo_model.y_s + (stretch_limo_model.a_b * stretch_limo_model.theta) - stretch_limo_model.y_rb
broken_vibration = broken_model.y_s + (broken_model.a_b * broken_model.theta) - broken_model.y_rb

axs_vib[0,0].plot(stretch_limo_model.time, fixed_vibration, color='blue')
axs_vib[0,0].set_title('Fixed simulation')

axs_vib[1,0].plot(broken_model.time, broken_vibration, color='blue')
axs_vib[1,0].set_title('Broken simulation')
